title: Research: capture PR #2540's early QQ16 records directly in their final output banks
head: a3b82e6f4ddcf999f8b6dcd3a6dfc3a9543a1533
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR #2540 captures sixteen early QQ16 values in separate R banks, then copies them into the selected X output banks Z after B1. This conditional construction captures directly into Z and holds those owned banks through B1. It reduces distinct owned full-cover banks from **240 to 224** and scalar primitive allowance from **17,472 to 17,280**, preserving all 224 output arrays in F_U1 and all 224 borrowed current fields.

The complete added local invoice is 840 unit ADDs, 832 quarter ADDs, 288 CLEARs, 224 rank-one children, 16 rank-eight children, 480 native wrappers and 208 cover maps. The native rank mass remains 352. All 448 native events and the 2,366-event decoder suffix are literally unchanged. The changed premise is early exclusive availability and retention of the sixteen selected output banks. Sixteen retained values and sixteen owner-local scratch arrays are still required.

The package `research/qq16-output-bank-retention/` contains the simulation proof, exact transformed word, complete invoice, source pins and a code-disjoint formal-operator checker. This is a conditional local construction, not a new information bound, global memory minimum, admitted supplier or kappa result. The selected construction is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Base main: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; priority revision 4.

Exact predecessor/dependency heads:

- PR #2540: `630d557af5088f66b45c447969cee9576600e50b` (literal word and proof directly retained).
- PR #2511: `f40e74a27f7c8781feea06a1571dc99ed5d9a004` (inherited logical inverse).
- PR #2512: `851dd3486a2d0549b51e85978a65ccb4eec619c0` (inherited current-frame native operations).

Task card:

- **Task ID / scope key:** `joint-query-controller` / `0e34adbc1dd119161c3a`; refined object `PR #2540/early-X1-to-final-Z/owned-bank-coalescing`.
- **Selection:** nonce `11933732c1a8cf169364b4d0a2c21d47`, recursive-interfaces, third suggestion. Connector alphabet and centre sharing suggestions were passed over for this concrete central lifetime handoff.
- **Concrete question:** remove PR #2540's separate R storage and intermediate copy/retirement while retaining its current-frame endpoint and borrowed-source restoration.
- **Scope status:** changed from a complete controller to one bounded local resource improvement answering PR #2540's first open question on lifetimes.
- **Changed restriction:** permit final Z_V outputs to be owned and held before B1; retain every physical native operation and the caller's obligation to supply retention.
- **Method/domain:** exact literal rewrite; all 112 ports, 16 selected ports, 240 temporal source symbols; arbitrary owned dirt; rational coefficients and formal noncommuting operators. A dimension-independent simulation proof carries the unchanged suffix.
- **Nearest work:** [PR #2540](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2540) supplies the decoder with separate banks; [PR #2511](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2511) proves its logical inverse and retention dimension; [PR #2512](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2512) and [PR #2524](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2524) address L2 frames; [PR #2480](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2480) gives a different fixed-interface retention floor. This changes the exact storage lifetimes and copy bill, not those theorems.
- **Complete local budget:** saves 16*8+32*2=192 scalar primitives and 16 bank identities; native children/maps, 16 retained values and local scratch stay as priced above. No whole-supplier moment improvement is inferred.
- **Success/stop test and cap:** all outputs, borrowed restoration, frame/ownership contract and complete invoice must agree; stop on any mismatch. One 60-minute budget, no larger search.
- **Artifact/reproduction:** `README.md`, `WORD.json`, `RESULT.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `TASK.json` and registered verifier in the new package; command below. Predecessor credit is retained.

Final refresh at 2026-10-15T16:24:10Z found canonical main and PR #2540 unchanged. Overlap queries covered the decoder name, early output, retention alias, capture directly and the new package name. The final complete snapshot had 812 open PRs at 16:22:35Z and 1261 Discussion records at 16:12:28Z. No matching lifetime result was identified; cached coverage is not a novelty guarantee. The claim is in [discussion #2617](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2617). A closing overlap scan also read the complete 1,276-record Discussion snapshot at 16:27:10Z and found only this claim and the direct predecessor for the precise lifetime scope. Structured task and freshness details are in `TASK.json`.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, Linux x86_64, standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-output-bank-retention
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-output-bank-retention --check-only
```

Observed:

```text
PASS_QQ16_OUTPUT_BANK_RETENTION banks=240->224 scalar=17472->17280 native_mass=352 outputs=224 borrowed=224 controls=15 no_new_kappa
Ran 6 tests ... OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-output-bank-retention outcome=completed
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

The exact differential checker compares every formal output operator and both 112-output checkpoints, verifies all 224 borrowed physical source restorations and scratch cleanup, and checks literal native-event/suffix equality. Fifteen semantic controls cover capture timing/source/sign/frame, output dirt, destructive clears, wrong native maps, source restoration and scratch leakage. Six artifact groups cover read-only Git-free export, source/live-price/candidate corruption, typed-receipt corruption and overwrite refusal. `git diff --check` passed.

The unmodified PR #2540 registered suite was separately reproduced at its pinned head:

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-complete-native-decoder
```

It passed its native/logical checks and six test groups. This reproduces predecessor evidence; it is not an independent native proof. The new formal interpreter uses the predecessor coarse frame contracts and proves a transformation, not supplier admission.

Unchecked obligations: early physical output allocation, retention and movement costs, full native hosting, precision/tape and output-consumer costs, global controller and all-size admission. No Lean or selected full cold replay was run. The selected record is unchanged.

## Open next questions

The package README and structured `TASK.json` identify two bounded follow-ups. First assign the sixteen early Z lifetimes to actual owners/streams and price retention and movement under a physical caller; bank availability and global tariffs are the blockers. Separately, test whether owner-local scratch can legally use not-yet-produced Y output slices; their physical access contracts must be proved before scalar lifetime overlap is treated as storage reuse.
